name: Alter Ego Media S.A.
summary: Alter Ego Media S.A. operates digital television broadcasting and radio stations. It operates MEGA, a television channel; and news media outlets, such as To Vima, Ta Nea, and Oikomikos Tachydromos. The company also owns My Radio, a radio station; ALTER EGO STUDIOS, a production company; MORE MEDIA, a content creation company; and ALTER EGO VENTURES, invests in startups and technologies related to the media and entertainment ecosystem.
